item.title: American Airlines London Flights Are Serving Meals Flown Over From the U.S. — Bare-Minimum Catering, Business Class Loses Ice Cream
item.description: American Airlines has a catering mess in London right now, so it’s loading two flights worth of meals in the U.S. and flying them over—then relying on that stock for the return trip. The result is bare-minimum service, with limited entrée choices and no ice cream up front, because there simply isn’t enough galley space to carry full catering both ways.
